77% of remote job listings hide pay. But that's not necessarily bad news.

A new analysis from Loker Dollar reveals that out of 4,441 active remote listings, only 1,000 (23%) include a salary or hourly figure. The remaining 77% keep compensation private, challenging the common belief that remote jobs are always upfront about pay.

Key findings:
- 2,753 listings (62%) are open to worldwide applicants.
- Communication is the top required skill (39% of listings), followed by AI (12%).
- 1,427 engineering roles are open, with 276 posted this week.

Among five highlighted companies, only Neo Financial discloses pay ($5/hour). TELUS Health, IDG, Hitachi, and Jobgether do not.

Contrarian take: Lack of pay info doesn't mean low wages—many firms expect candidates to negotiate.

Browse the live board, filter for 'worldwide remote,' and apply before listings close.

Full analysis: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/global-remote-jobs-2026
